desc:
🪓 Welcome to Axe Battles!

🎯 Throw your axe at enemies!

🛡️ Block & parry incoming axes to send them flying back!

⚡ React FAST! You only have 1 SECOND!

💀 Miss your axe catch or parry? YOU DIE!

🔥 Unlock NEW axes with UNIQUE abilities!

🏆 Battle players, master your timing, and become the BEST axe fighter!

**⚔️ THROW → PARRY → CATCH → SURVIVE → REPEAT!**

👍 Like the game for more updates!
